name: extensions
description: Offline production dashboard, swarm, workflow and btw walkthrough. Load those trusted local packages with start --extension. Children only emit scripted text; no shell, network or worktree calls.
prompt: Start the offline audit groups and delegate an inspection.

args.goal: Inspect narrow terminal layouts and keyboard navigation without changing files

tasks.title: Inspect terminal fixture
tasks.prompt: Describe terminal fixture behavior without tools.

main.text: Audit ready. The groups use only the loopback scripted provider. Open /dashboard, /swarm view, /workflow view and /btw Explain the layout.
Offline groups settled. No real files were read or changed.

layout.text: Layout review: keep selection, state and task labels readable at narrow widths. No files changed.

keys.text: Keyboard review: test Tab and F6, then left/right pane keys. Keep the focused pane visible.

workflow-child.text:
## Narrow layout review

Selection and focus should remain distinct. Keep the task name reachable after resizing.

- Wide: inspect both panes.
- Narrow: inspect details and return to list.

No tools were called.

delegate.text: The delegated terminal fixture inspection completed. No tools were called and no files were changed.

child.text:
## Side answer

Tab switches focus only when the active view permits it. F6 returns focus between the extension and main input.

| Key | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [ | List pane |
| ] | Details pane |

- Keep the focused pane visible.
- Use Escape to close the side question.

This answer is scripted locally; no files or network were used.
